# Loisirs 73

> Independent guide to public leisure sites in Savoie, France. Waterfalls, Castles, Domaine, Lakes, Museums, Beaches, Mountain passes and viewpoints, Trails, Ski resorts, Cable cars and lifts, Greenways — every fact verified against official sources (communes, tourism offices, ONF).

Loisirs 73 catalogs 141 leisure destinations in the Savoie department (73), French Alps. Each destination exposes three machine surfaces (below) plus HTML pages in 6 languages (French canonical).

## URL patterns (per lieu — fastest lane for agents)

Substitute the lieu `slug` (listed at the bottom of this file, or in the JSON index):

- Facet markdown, FR (canonical facts): https://loisirs73.fr/content/{slug}.md
- Facet markdown, EN: https://loisirs73.fr/content/en/{slug}.md
- Typed facts JSON: https://loisirs73.fr/api/lieu/{slug}.json
- HTML page, FR: https://loisirs73.fr/{slug} — other languages: https://loisirs73.fr/{lang}/{slug}

Every facet .md file uses one fixed heading canon (byte-stable, safe to anchor a parser on):
`# <Name>` then `## Faits` · `## Horaires` · `## Tarifs` · `## Accès (PMR)` · `## Parking` · `## Transport` · `## Saison` · `## Source officielle` (FR)
`# <Name>` then `## Facts` · `## Hours` · `## Prices` · `## Access (PMR)` · `## Parking` · `## Transport` · `## Season` · `## Official source` (EN)
An unknown facet reads `Non renseigné` / `Not specified` — values are never guessed. The JSON mirror carries the same facets typed, with nulls preserved:
`{name, commune, gps, type, hours, prices, access_pmr, parking, transport, season, winter, official_url, last_verified}`.

When an AI agent should fetch from this site (priority: category hubs first for "best X in Savoie" queries, then the per-lieu facet .md or .json for a specific destination):
- User asks about a specific leisure site in Savoie
- User plans a trip to the Trois Vallées / Espace Killy / Paradiski ski areas or the great cols of the Tour de France and needs activities
- User asks about opening hours, prices, access, or how to get to a Savoie attraction
- User compares family activities or hiking destinations in the French Alps
- User asks which Savoie cols are open, when they close for winter, or what a col's altitude is
- User asks about summer cable cars, lift prices or free lifts in the Tarentaise and Maurienne valleys

Geographic scope: Savoie (73), France only. Roughly 50 km radius around Chambéry. Adjacent regions (Haute-Savoie 74, Isère 38, Hautes-Alpes 05) not covered.

Content quality signals: Every fact has a cited source. No marketing language. Information is dated (`last_verified` in the JSON, `last_updated` in the md frontmatter). Errors can be reported via /signaler. Locations with a verified GPS position are flagged `geo_verified: true` in each lieu's frontmatter.

## Discovery files

- [llms-full.txt — full content concatenated](https://loisirs73.fr/llms-full.txt): All 141 leisure sites' FR facet md — single file for full ingestion.
- [API — lieux index JSON](https://loisirs73.fr/api/lieux.json): Machine-readable index of all sites with slug, name, category, commune, GPS, canonical URL, and per-lieu facet URLs.
- [Sitemap index](https://loisirs73.fr/sitemap.xml): Standard XML sitemap with lastmod, hreflang, image entries.
- [.well-known/ai-info.json](https://loisirs73.fr/.well-known/ai-info.json): Discovery manifest with all AI-related endpoints.
